note: An entry is a hint for an owner claim, never authorization. A path matching an entry is a starting point for proving the owning product manages it, not proof. Commands are data for an operator to read; nothing here runs them. Paths are relative to the home directory. A null command means the product has none; manual_step names the in-app or settings action instead.

entries.destructive_native_command: docker image prune; docker builder prune

verification.claim: docker system df reports reclaimable space; docker image prune and docker builder prune are the owner's removal commands; the two data paths were seen on a Windows and a macOS host
basis: operator probe of the data paths recorded in issue 4006, no official page found
verification.recheck: a Docker CLI release note that renames or removes one of the three commands, or a Docker Desktop release note that moves its data directory

entries.manual_step: Manual step in Windows Disk Cleanup: select DirectX Shader Cache

verification.claim: the NVIDIA shader cache sits under the listed Windows path and Windows Disk Cleanup offers a DirectX Shader Cache item
basis: operator probe recorded in issue 4006, no official page fetched
verification.recheck: an NVIDIA driver release note that moves the shader cache, or a Windows build whose Disk Cleanup drops the DirectX Shader Cache item

verification.claim: Cursor keeps its state under the listed per-platform user-data paths and offers in-app cache clearing
basis: operator probe recorded in issue 4006, no official page fetched
verification.recheck: a Cursor changelog entry that moves the user-data directory or removes in-app cache clearing

entries.manual_step: Adjust Codex history retention in its configuration

verification.claim: Codex keeps user configuration under ~/.codex and config.toml offers history.max_bytes and history.persistence
verification.recheck: a Codex release note that changes the config directory or the history.* keys

verification.claim: chezmoi's default cacheDir is ~/.cache/chezmoi on every listed platform and chezmoi doctor checks for problems
verification.recheck: a chezmoi release note that changes the default cacheDir or the doctor command

verification.claim: the plugin cache lives under ~/.pulumi by default, pulumi about prints environment information, pulumi plugin ls lists the cache, and pulumi plugin rm (alias of remove) deletes cached plugins
verification.recheck: a Pulumi CLI release note that changes the plugin cache location or the plugin ls, plugin rm or about commands
